digest.component_or_area: LLM verdict signing and sidecar payloads
propositions: Signed LLM verdicts currently record only a model string without provider, endpoint, or tier information, making it impossible to distinguish verdicts from different providers or deployment tiers

A new additive provider_provenance object must be added to verdict payloads recording provider, model, endpoint_host, tier, and capabilities without breaking backward compatibility or altering signatures on legacy payloads
Provenance must be assembled once in runner.run() from already-resolved capabilities and threaded through all three sidecar writers (plan_review, completion, code_review) without recomputation
The endpoint_host field must extract only the hostname via urlparse().hostname to exclude credentials, and persisted payloads must contain no credential material from base_url or api_key

Verdicts from best_effort tiers (Ollama, custom endpoints) must still be signed to preserve the contributor on-ramp, but consumers must have the tier information to reject off-tier verdicts if policy requires it
The provenance record must reuse the ModelCapabilities object that actually drove the run, never recompute it, to ensure the signed record matches the capabilities that governed execution
